english.idiomatic: Huan married the daughter of Dou Ninggu, minister of rites, who was somewhat advanced in years. On the wedding night, when the bride came out to pay respects, Tao bowed low in the dust. Huan cried: "Elder brother, are you mad?
english.literal: Huan married the daughter of Minister of Rites Dou Ninggu, who was somewhat advanced in years. On the wedding night, when the Dou girl came out to pay respects, Tao at once bowed in the dust. Huan cried in alarm: "Elder brother, are you mad?
